685135.note: Hwacheon County has confirmed the 2027 festival for Jan 9–31 (23 days) on the frozen Hwacheon Stream in Hwacheon-eup. Detailed programs and advance booking for ice fishing will be posted later on the official site (narafestival.com) and county channels. For 2027 the county is reviewing a higher adult ice-fishing fee — KRW 25,000 with KRW 15,000 returned as local vouchers, up from KRW 15,000 in 2026 — so check the final price before you go.
685135.noteFoot: Sources: Hwacheon County announcement reported by Gukje News (Nov 13, 2026); Aju Business Daily (Oct 2, 2026) for the fee plan. Checked Nov 25, 2026.
685135.desc: Jan 9–31, 2027 · Hwacheon, Gangwon. Ice fishing for mountain trout on the frozen stream, ice sledding and ice sculptures; Seoul day tours Jan 11–31.

aff.lead: No car? A day tour from Seoul runs daily Jan 11–31, 2027 (pickup at Hongik Univ. Stn, near Myeongdong Stn and Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Stn; festival admission, ice fishing and sledding included; foreign passport holders only; book by 5 pm two days before)
aff.text: See the Hwacheon ice festival day tour from Seoul
